sloka: धूम गन्धम् वपायाः तु जिघ्रति स्म नराधिपः ।यथा कालम् यथा न्यायम् निर्णुदन् पापम् आत्मनः ॥१-१४-३७॥
transliteration: dhūma gandham vapāyāḥ tu jighrati sma narādhipaḥ ।yathā kālam yathā nyāyam nirṇudan pāpam ātmanaḥ ॥1-14-37॥

translations.english: In other sacrifices oblations are offered with branches of a plaksha tree but in Aswamedha a branch of cane creeper is chosen instead.
